Title: See the current streak
User Story: As a person building habits, I want to see how many days in a row I checked off a habit, so that I stay motivated.
User Acceptance Criteria: AC1: Given a habit checked off on each of the last 3 days, when I open the habit list, then it shows a streak of 3.

Title: See the best streak
User Story: As a person building habits, I want to see the longest streak a habit has had, so that I know my best run.
User Acceptance Criteria: AC1: Given a habit whose longest run was 5 days and whose current streak is 2, when I open the habit list, then it shows a best streak of 5.

Title: Count focus sessions by category
User Story: As a person who focuses in sessions, I want to see how many focus sessions I ran for each task category, so that I know where my time goes.
User Acceptance Criteria: AC1: Given 2 coding sessions and 1 writing session, when I open the focus view, then it shows 2 for coding and 1 for writing.
